text:
Wohlgebohrner Herr!
besonders hochzuehrender Herr Bau und Oeco¬
nomie-Rath!
Zur Resignation der Betscher Güter ist in dem
heutigem Termin der Cammerfiskal abermals
nicht erschienen, weil er von der Cammer noch
keine Autorisation erhalten. Ich habe nun
zwar nochmals um die Ansetzung eines neu¬
en Termins gebeten, aber die Sache wird kein
Ende nehmen, wenn die Cammer nicht endlich
einmahl dem Fiscal ganz ordentliche Anwei¬
sung giebt, daß und was er resigniren soll.
Wann Ihro hochfürstl. Durchlaucht geruhen
möchten den Cammer Præsidenten v. Harlem
um die Beschleunigung anzugehen, so würden
wir wohl einmahl zum Zweck kommen.
Ich habe die Ehre mit der vollkommensten
[H?]achachtung zu seyn.
Ew. Wohlgebohrnen
ganz ergebenster Diener
Posen den 25. Januar
1802
Melzer.
Verte
In diesem Augenblick erhalte ich das Appellat
Erkentniß in der Sache mit dem Dohm Capitel
und Kruhtswitz, welche Herr Riedel in erster
Instantz geführt hatte. Es ist reformator
ausgefallen, u das Dohm Capitel mit seinem
Ferdicus[?] abgewiesen worden. Von unser Sei¬
strum nur also mit dem Erkentniß sehr zu
frieden seyn. Ich habe[?], die anbey de[?]
Erkennen so zu über schicken
M[?]

translation.en:
Your Honour!

Particularly Highly Honoured Sir, Councillor of Building and Economy!

For the resignation of the Betsche estates, the Chamber fiscal has once again failed to appear at today's hearing, because he has as yet received no authorisation from the Chamber. I have indeed once more requested that a new hearing be appointed, but the matter will never come to an end unless the Chamber at last gives the fiscal a properly drawn instruction that he is to resign, and what he is to resign. If His Most Serene Highness might be pleased to approach the Chamber President von Harlem for an expediting of the business, we should surely at some point attain our object.

I have the honour to be, with the most perfect [uncertain: esteem],

Your Honour's most devoted servant

Posen, the 25th of January 1802

Melzer.

Turn over

At this very moment I receive the appellate judgment in the matter with the Cathedral Chapter and Kruhtswitz, which Mr Riedel had conducted in the first instance. It has come out as a reversal, and the Cathedral Chapter has been dismissed with its [uncertain: Ferdicus]. On our si [text lost] therefore be very well satisfied with the judgment. I have[?], the enclosed [illegible] judgment thus to for ward M[?]

text_english:
Your Honour!

Particularly Highly Honoured Sir, Councillor of Building and Economy!

For the resignation of the Betsche estates, the Chamber fiscal has once again failed to appear at today's hearing, because he has as yet received no authorisation from the Chamber. I have indeed once more requested that a new hearing be appointed, but the matter will never come to an end unless the Chamber at last gives the fiscal a properly drawn instruction that he is to resign, and what he is to resign. If His Most Serene Highness might be pleased to approach the Chamber President von Harlem for an expediting of the business, we should surely at some point attain our object.

I have the honour to be, with the most perfect [uncertain: esteem],

Your Honour's most devoted servant

Posen, the 25th of January 1802

Melzer.

Turn over

At this very moment I receive the appellate judgment in the matter with the Cathedral Chapter and Kruhtswitz, which Mr Riedel had conducted in the first instance. It has come out as a reversal, and the Cathedral Chapter has been dismissed with its [uncertain: Ferdicus]. On our si [text lost] therefore be very well satisfied with the judgment. I have[?], the enclosed [illegible] judgment thus to for ward M[?]
summary_en: Melzer reports from Posen that the Chamber's fiscal officer again failed to appear at the hearing for the resignation of the Betsche estates, having still received no authorisation, and that the business will not conclude until the Chamber instructs him plainly what he is to resign; he asks that the Prince press Chamber President von Harlem to expedite it. A postscript notes an appeal judgment in the case with the Cathedral Chapter and Kruhtswitz has been reversed in their favour.
summary_de: Meldung Melzers an einen Bau- und Wirtschaftsrat, dass der Kammerfiskal zum Termin über die Resignation der Betscher Güter erneut nicht erschienen ist, weil ihm die Kammer noch keine Vollmacht erteilt hat; ein neuer Termin ist beantragt, doch werde die Sache erst vorangehen, wenn die Kammer dem Fiskal eine klare Anweisung gibt, was er zu resignieren hat. Vorgeschlagen wird, der Fürst möge Kammerpräsident von Harlem um Beschleunigung angehen. Nachschrift: das Appellationsurteil in der Sache mit dem Domkapitel und Kruhtswitz ist zugunsten der eigenen Seite ausgefallen.
